༄༅/ /rig pa sems kyi gegs sel ye shes dri med bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rig pa sems kyi gegs sel ye shes

dri med bzhugs so/ / phan bde'i sprin gtsang ye shes char 'bebs pa/ /kun mkhyen sman pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal te/ /'od gsal gnad du bsnun pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rig pa ye shes gegs sel bri bar bya/ /de'ang mngon sum snying po'i don sgom pa'i tshe/ so so rang gi rig pa'i ye shes ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i snying po can/ snying ga na gnas pa'i gdangs nyams su blangs pas/ rig pa dngos 'pho 'gyur med pa nang gi dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pas sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang la gnas pa ni gnad 'phyugs pa med pa ste/ skad cig gis gdod ma'i gzhi la phyin nas/ stong gsal rang byung ye shes la gnas pa yin no/ /de'ang lus gnad dang*/ gzigs stangs gcun te bsgoms pas/ las dang po pa kha cig /bying nas tshad pa shas che bas gnyid rmugs su gyur na/ gsal stong gi ye shes nyams te/ gti mug tu rmugs pa yin pas/ bying ba bseng ba'i thabs ni/ nyi grib kyi mtshams su 'dug ste/ reg pa hur bton la gzigs stangs bskyed de lta zhing*/ skabs su chu grang mos gdong dag par bkru zhing*/ phyogs mtho la gnam rgya yangs sar bsgoms pas bseng zhing*/ ha dang a mang du brjod la/ rlung phyir gzung ba shin tu gces so/ /de nas gsal stong dwangs la mi g.yo ba 'byung ngo*/ /yang 'od snang la/ bltas kyang sems 'phro na/ rlung nang du bzung la mig phyir lta/ rig pa snying kar a dkar po gsal zhing 'tsher ba gcig la gtad pas/ spro bsdu med pa'i shes pa dwangs gsal 'gags pa med pa 'char ro/ /skabs su nags khrod dang dma' zhing 'thibs sar bsgom pa gnad do/ /yang nam mkha' la rgyang ring por bltas pas/ 'od snang yang ma mthong*/ mig shas kyang ngan na/ zim bus smin mtshams su bltas pas/ snang ba sna tshogs su 'char te/ der gtad nas bsgoms pas mig gsal la snang ba gsal ba ni gnad dam pa'o/ /yang snang ba'i nyams la spros par mthong nas a 'thas su song ba dang*/

stong nyams la zhen pa byung na/ sku dang ye shes dbyer med zung 'jug gi dgongs pa la yid ches bya zhing*/ rnam rtog cung zad mgo non pa'i sems gnad tsam khams gong ma'i bag chags sog byed du bstan pa yin la rtog pas rtog pa la lta ba dang*/ rnam rtog gi dra ba las ma 'das pas 'khor ba'i bag chags su bstan pa rnams kyi rgyu mtshan yid la byas pas sel lo/ /yang snang nyams la zhen na gang snang rmi lam sgyu mar thag gcad/ snang stong bden med zang thal du la bzla/ mthar zhen 'dzin 'khrul ba med par gtan la dbab/ gang snang bden med zang thal du rtsal sbyong ngo*/ /yang snang ba la bltas pas sems gnas tsam pa las/ snang rig gi steng du rang gsal stong pa'i chod ma byung bar 'thas nas/ snang sems bsre ma shes pa'i skyon yin pas cir snang stong gzugs ltar rang snang bden med/ zang thal 'dzin med/ ye stong rtsa bral/ med snang sna tshogs su dpe don sbyar zhing phyi snang ba'i yul thams cad bden med 'al 'ol du rtsal sbyong*/ nang 'gyu ba'i sems kyang shar shar 'dra yang*/ ngos gzung med par bar snang gi 'ja' tshon ltar thag gcad/ rang gsal sems gnas kyi sgom pa de'ang snang gzugs ltar rig pa'i rang gdangs rang gnas chen po mtha' grol gcig tu rtsal sbyangs te/ gang la'ang zhen 'dzin dang*/ bden zhen med pa rmi lam 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam du mos pa bya'o/ /mdor na rang byung ye shes kyi ngo bo/ rang sar gnas pas/ dgongs pa nam mkha' lta bur stong gsal spros pa dang bral ba khong nas shar ba ni/ gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po'i don la dbang 'byor ba ste/ bying rgod dang*/ mthar 'dzin dang*/ rtsol sgrub dang*/ spang gnyen gyi 'khris ma zhugs par rig ge seng nge*/ wal le/ ye re/ snang nge*/ phyam me/ khyab be/ brdal le/ phyir snang 'od gdangs la mig gis bltas kyang*/ blo'i 'dzin pa ma zhugs/ nang gnas ting nge 'dzin la ngang gis gnas kyang*/ chags zhen gyi nyams kyis ma bslad/

phyi nang bar gsum phyam gdal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du gnas pa ni mngon sum snying tig gi dgongs pa ma nor ba la blo 'jog pa zhes bya'o/ /de'i tshe kun gzhi rnam shes dang bcas pa'i sems dang*/ nyon yid yid shes dang bcas pa'i yid dang*/ sgo lnga so sor zhen pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang bral ba/ 'od gsal ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin las mi g.yo zhing*/ rnam pa ma dor ba ni thugs rje'i gsang ba'o/ /de'ang sems dang bral bas bsam gtan gyi bag chags rang zad de/ gzugs su skye ba'i las med/ yin rtog med rtse gcig pa tsam dang bral bas/ gzugs med du skye ba'i mtha' stong*/ rtog bcas gzung 'dzin dang bral bas 'dod par skye ba'i las med/ ma dag pa'i sa rdo ri brag la sogs pa phyi 'khrul pa'i mthong byed mig gi rnam shes la sogs pa lnga/ 'od gsal la bltas pas rang 'gags shing bral bas 'khor bar skye ba'i yul bag chags kyi gzhi stongs te/ 'khor bar skye mkhan 'khrul ba'i sems/ skyes yul/ skye byed bag chags gsum med pas tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas thob pa'i gnad do/ /bsdu na rig pa ye shes kyi gol sa dang*/ sgrib pa sems su shar bas/ lta stangs gzigs stangs la sogs pas sems 'gags ye shes mi g.yo snang rig 'dzin med chen por la bzla ba ni/ gsang ba snying tig gi dgongs pa mthar thug pa yin no/ /mdo rgyud thams cad nas bag chags sems la brten pas rtog med du gzhag pa dang*/ bden gnyis las sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa'i sgro btags rnam pa can rtog yin/ zhes pa dang*/ 'jug pa las/ sems 'gags pa de sku yi mngon sum mdzad/ ces pa la sogs pa gsungs pas/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'dod kyang*/ khyed phye ba ni 'di lta bu gzhan med de/ sems 'gags nas bems po dang 'dra snyam du zhen pa ste rig pa'i ye shes mi 'gag cing gsal ba'i gnad ma shes pas rmongs pa yin no/ /'di ni sems 'gags pa dang*/

ye shes gsal bas ma nor ba'i sgom byed pa thams cad kyi dus na de ltar 'dod pa yin no/ /bla med snying po'i theg pa mchog gi lam/ /ji bzhin bshad las deng sang bsod nams shig /thob ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /ma lus nyer zhi spros kun bral bar shog / gsang ba snying tig gi gnad las/ rig pa sems kyi gegs sel ye shes dri med ces bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa rdzogs so/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // rig pa sems kyi gegs sel ye shes dri med/mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (10) - PAGE 154 -- PAGE 153 -- PAGE 150 -
